messages:
Maya Chen: Quick heads-up — noticed a weird divergence in last 48h between Paid FB clicks -> MQLs and the 'campaign funnel' dashboard. Paid CPL looks flat but MQLs down ~18%.
Ethan Park: ugh, timeline? I can check ingestion. Any segment or utm attached?
Maya Chen: started ~2026-02-10 02:00 UTC (roughly). It's across US + EU paid cohorts. Link: https://redwood.app/dashboards/growth/campaigns
Priya Singh: I'm on it. Initial look shows ~30% of paid sessions missing utm_source. That would drop into 'direct' bucket -> MQL attr loss.
Noah Rivera: Could be the new redirect we pushed for the webinar landing last week. @Ethan did the redirect change also rewrite query params?
Ethan Park: I *think* we preserved query params but I pushed a small Nginx rule yesterday. Pasting the snippet I deployed:
```nginx
location /r/landing {
  proxy_pass http://webapp_internal/landing;
  proxy_set_header Host $host;
  proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
}
```
Ethan Park: Notably I forgot `proxy_pass_request_headers on;` — could be nuking query strings in some setups. Will check now.
Priya Singh: If that's it, attribution will shift to 'direct'. I can run a quick cohort to compare utm_present vs utm_missing across sources. SQL:
```sql
select date(event_ts) as d, count(*) filter (where utm_source is null) as missing, count(*) as total
from web_sessions
where campaign_id = 'q1-webinar'
group by 1
order by 1 desc
limit 14;
```
Priya Singh: Running — sending snapshot in 5.
metrics-bot: Alert: MQL-rate for paid-facebook down 19% vs baseline (14d). Trigger level: high.
Maya Chen: thanks. @Priya can you also pull last week's landing redirect logs? Need to see if 302 vs 301 changed.
Priya Singh: attaching top-line counts: missing utm jumped from ~8% -> 39% on 2026-02-10 02:17 UTC. Looks correlated with spike in /r/landing 302s.
Ethan Park: confirmed — my rule accidentally returned a 302 for a subset when the cookie domain matched. Reverting now.
Ethan Park: revert applied at 1745632240 (just now). Will monitor.
Noah Rivera: For the weekly exec deck, does this mean we should annotate the drop as 'attribution artifact' vs true lead drop?
Maya Chen: Yes annotate. Also let's add a short note in dashboard (annotations) and email ops + sales that we expect MQLs to return to baseline in next 24 h.
Priya Singh: After revert, missing utm % down to 10% in next 20 min sample. I'll update the dashboard also and bump the alert to 'investigating->resolved'.
Maya Chen: Awesome. Can someone follow up with the content team — they changed the short-url behavior for the webinar creative last week; want to make sure future links keep query params.
Noah Rivera: I'll own outreach. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Maya Chen: closing the loop — will re-run the weekly KPI export for Monday with note. End.
